caption: Aletsch Glacier, Bettmeralp
composition: Bettmerhorn viewpoint above Bettmeralp looking along the Great Aletsch Glacier · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Bettmerhorn viewpoint above Bettmeralp, the Great Aletsch Glacier runs as a long, crevassed ice stream marked by dark medial moraines and a wide curve. High peaks close the head of the ice and sit in cloud. The near ground is rock and low late-September alpine vegetation. The Open-Meteo model for this cell is overcast, so the light on the ice is flat and gray. No construction is added.
